A compact resolution summary for a comment set: a "resolved of total" bar plus a clickable chip per status. Pure presentation derived from `comments`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/comments/CommentProgress.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CommentProgress } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/comments";
```
